uncertainties: Reply nodes show the message part only; actual speech is '<caller>, <Spoken> <role>, <message>' with the caller rendered from the catalog match (e.g. 'viper 1 1' or modex digit words).
CR_Y_RB23/assignment sample uses CASE III; CASE II uses identical marshal/readback grammar (carrier.py 783-793) but EAT minute depends on mission time.

Sample BRC 353 / final 344 / radial 164 were derived from domain.true_to_magnetic for the test fixture (43N 41E, 2026-11-12 12:00Z); tests compute them the same way (test_carrier.py 24-25) rather than hard-coding them.
Spoken-word callsign 'Viper one one' (tests use 'Viper 1 1'); the parser resolves both to viper/1/1.

Positive pattern/ball/established replies need mission telemetry positions (CALL_RANGE_NM, BALL_*, OVERHEAD_NM, FIX_TOLERANCE_NM); parser-only tests cannot validate those nodes without a bridge snapshot.
CL_Y_EMERG 'emergency' on deck with no session enrols a recovery that the next snapshot closes (not airborne); it is not a launch-priority call unless a departure session exists.
No priority-withdrawal intent exists: any cancel word ends the whole session (carrier.py 1074-1080).
Clara synonyms 'no ball'/'negative ball' and pattern synonyms (dirty up, see me, final, leaving marshal, downwind) are accepted but not separately charted (one canonical phrase per intent).
Chart edges from the shared guard hub apply to every YOU call; per-call guard edges are not drawn to keep one readable chart.
